description: This source file defines a Python script that sets up a conversational bot utilizing Google Vertex AI's Gemini language model service. It includes configuration for various transports, register functions to fetch weather and restaurant recommendations, and defines the main run sequence for the bot, integrating speech processing, LLM invocation, and pipeline management.

classes.name: FunctionSchema
classes.description: Schema class for defining functions callable via the LLM, including name, description, properties, and required fields.

classes.name: ToolsSchema
classes.description: Schema class for grouping multiple tool definitions, such as weather, restaurant recommendations, etc.

classes.name: SileroVADAnalyzer
classes.description: Voice activity detection analyzer based on Silero models, used for VAD in audio streams.

classes.name: VADParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the VAD analyzer, e.g., stop seconds.

classes.name: LLMRunFrame
classes.description: Represents a frame for LLM execution within the processing pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Sequence of processing steps for handling conversational data, audio, and LLM interaction.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages execution of a pipeline, including starting, stopping, and handling signals.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Parameters controlling pipeline behavior, such as enabling metrics.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline along with its parameters and execution logic.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Holds conversational context for the LLM, such as user and assistant messages.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles the aggregation of LLM contexts from user and assistant perspectives.

classes.name: create_transport
classes.description: Utility to instantiate a transport object based on configuration and parameters.

classes.name: BaseTransport
classes.description: Abstract base class for different transport implementations.

classes.name: RunnerArguments
classes.description: Arguments provided at runtime for the bot's execution, such as timeout settings.

methods.name: fetch_weather_from_api(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to simulate fetching weather data, calling a callback with mocked data.

methods.name: fetch_restaurant_recommendation(params: FunctionCallParams)
methods.description: Async function to simulate fetching a restaurant recommendation.

methods.name: run_bot(transport: BaseTransport, runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Asynchronous main function to set up and run the bot's processing pipeline.

methods.name: bot(runner_args: RunnerArguments)
methods.description: Entry point for the bot's main execution, creating transport and starting the run sequence.
